sous_titre: Nombre de transactions de logements enregistrées par mois, mars à juillet 2026

Mars 2026.texte: the total number of housing transactions recorded in the month of March was 19,381, a year-on-year increase of nearly 13 percent

Avril 2026.texte: the total number of housing transactions recorded in the month of April was 19,454, a year-on-year increase of nearly 3 percent

Mai 2026.texte: the total number of housing transactions recorded in the month of May was 19,120, a year-on-year decrease of 2.5 percent

Juin 2026.texte: the total number of housing transactions recorded in the month of June was 20,378, a year-on-year increase of 7.9 percent

Juillet 2026.texte: The total number of housing transactions recorded in the month of July was 22,241, a year-on-year increase of 5.0 percent.
